**Methodology.** Single-variable panel swap on the pinned #558 instrument (issue-558 @ 18959f7f, adapted to issue-562 IDs). 12 adapters × 5 cells × 50 held-out questions, key present in all cells, greedy vLLM, 4-float slot stats trained AND base via disable_adapter() in the same forward pass.
